svg.title: Oil refinery loading animation
svg.desc: Animated oil refinery scene with pump jack, flare tower, storage tanks, and a circular progress indicator in red and green

circle.style: animation: arcFill 2.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate;;fill:none;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);stroke-width:8px;stroke-dasharray:502px, 1570px;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Anthropic Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

g.style: transform-origin:340px 340px; animation: spinDot 2.5s linear infinite;;fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke:none;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Anthropic Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto

transform-origin:222px 240px; animation: flameRed 1.1s ease-in-out infinite;;fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke:none;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:0.941506;font-family:"Anthropic Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto
